headline: Prime ESE angle but short and quick — dawn glass before the wind swings.
today: Best chunk of the week's early swell is here at 2-3ft on a prime ESE line, just gutless at 4-6s. Dawn has cross-off NE with the tide starting to push off the 5:36 low, so grab the mid-morning window before the wind clocks E and turns everything crossed. Log or fish to make the most of the short period, and don't dawdle past noon.

daysToWatch.note: Best home day of the stretch — 2-3ft E at a good angle with cross-off NNE in the morning going light by afternoon. Groveler or log, ride the morning.
Drops to knee-high and stays there through Saturday. Flat spell, skip it unless you just want to float.
